other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Continuous municipal wastewater treatment line coupled with anaerobic digestion producing biogas (continuous processing with gravity feed)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The first one is through the CAS associate
with an Anaerobic Digestion (AD) to produce biogas through
feeding from primary clarifier and secondary clarifier by
gravity and mechanical thickener.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Continuous multi-stage flow-through plant with reactor zones (MBBR/HYBAS aeration tanks operating as a continuous biological treatment process)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
There are four MBBR aeration tanks and each tank is
divided into four reactor zones; (1) Anoxic zone, (2) Activated
sludge zone (AS), (3) Hybrid zone, and (4) De-Oxygen zone.

one_line: Empirical energy-audit case study comparing conventional activated sludge and moving bed biofilm reactor systems at municipal sewage treatment plants in Malaysia, computing energy performance indices from 2013–2016 plant data.
